subject: si
title: SI.------RT.OP.
description: Diagram in NYM-26, the first of two on book p392. Note this is a *tree* diagram (not a crossing), structurally distinct from most NYM schematics. (C)SI (the concept of source initiation) → PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) → (C)RT-ALGN (the concept of reality alignment). RT-ALGN branches into RT-OP (reality options), (R)PART (real participation), and (R)STY (the reality of stylism). RT-OP has a *dashed* edge to SOC-RT (social reality). Structural argument: this is Braxton's diagrammatic specification of how source initiation, *as a concept*, propagates through progressional continuance into the conceptual reality alignment, which then branches into the trio of practical outcomes — reality options, real participation, and real stylism. The dashed edge from reality-options to social-reality registers as conditional: meaning reality options' actual realization in social reality is not guaranteed, only conditional. Read against the section: this is Braxton's tree-form specification of why the post-Ayler movement is best understood as *stylism* (NYM-22's claim) rather than restructuralism — in this diagram, real stylism is one of three sibling outcomes of conceptual reality alignment, on equal footing with reality options and participation. Stylism is not a lesser outcome — it is one of the three productive outputs of source initiation processed through progressional continuance.
